<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. VIII.|ACCORDING TO S. IOHN.|243}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=8|verse=21}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Munday in the 2 weeke of Lent.}}Againe therfore {{sc|Iesvs}} said to them, I goe, and you shal seeke me, and shal die in your sinne. VVhither I goe, you can not come. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=22}}† The Ievves therfore said, VVhy, vvil he kil him self, because he saith, Vvhither I goe, you can not come? {{verse|chapter=8|verse=23}}† And he said to them, You are from beneath, I am from aboue. you are of this vvorld, I am not of this vvorld. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=24}}† Therfore I said to you that you shal die in your sinnes. for if you beleeue not that I am he, you shal die in your sinne. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=25}}† They said therfore to him, VVho art thou? {{sc|Iesvs}} said to them, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ So read S. Cyril, S. Ambrose, & S. Augustine: expounding it of Christes person, that he is the beginning or cause of al creatures.}}∷ The beginning vvho also speake to you. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=26}}† Many things I haue to speake and iudge of you. but he that sent me, is true: and vvhat I haue heard of him, these things I speake in the vvorld. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=27}}† And they knevv not that he said to them that his father vvas God. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=28}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore said to them, VVhen you shal haue exalted the sonne of man, then you shal knovv that I am he, and of my self I doe nothing, but as the Father hath taught me, these things I speake: {{verse|chapter=8|verse=29}}† and he that sent me, is vvith me: and he hath not left me alone, because the things that please him I doe alvvaies.⊣ {{verse|chapter=8|verse=30}}† Vvhen he spake these things, many beleeued in him.

{{verse|chapter=8|verse=31}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore said to them that beleeued him, the Ievves: If you {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Onely faith is not sufficient without perseuêrance or abiding in the keeping of his cōmaundements.}}∷ abide in my vvorde, you shal be my disciples in deede. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=32}}† And you shal knovv the truth, and the truth shal make you free. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=33}}† They ansvvered him, VVe are the seed of Abraham, and vve neuer serued any man: hovv saiest thou, You shal be free? {{verse|chapter=8|verse=34}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered them, {{sup|‖}} Amen, amen I say to you, that {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ro. 6, 16. 2. Pet. 2, 19.''}}* euery one vvhich committeth sinne, is the seruant of sinne. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=35}}† and the seruant abideth not in the house for euer: the sonne abideth for euer. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=36}}† If therfore the sonne make you free, you shal be {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Man was neuer without free wil: but hauing the grace of Christ, his wil is truely made free (as S. Augustine saith) from seruitude of sinne also. ''tract. 41 in Euang. Io''.}}∷ free in deede. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=37}}† I knovv that you are the children of Abraham: but you seeke to kil me, because my vvorde taketh not in you. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=38}}† I speake that vvhich I haue seen vvith my father: and you doe the things that you haue seen vvith your father. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=39}}† They ansvvered, and said to him, Our father is Abraham. {{sc|Iesvs}} saith to them, If you be the children of Abraham, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Not onely faith but good workes also make men the children of Abraham. according as S. Iames also speaketh of Abrahams workes c. 2.}}∷ doe the vvorkes of Abraham. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=40}}† But novv, you seeke to kil me, a man that haue spoken the truth to you, vvhich I haue heard of God. this did not Abraham. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=41}}† You doe the vvorkes of your father. They said therfore to him, VVe vvere not borne of fornication. vve haue one father, God. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=42}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore said to them, If<noinclude>{{rh||Hh ij|God}}</noinclude>
